theme_and_archetype.description: A modern, premium, and approachable design tailored for young French urbanites. Relies on a crisp white backdrop, bold deep violet accents, and generous negative space to make the products the hero. Rejects typical 'tech-bro' darkness in favor of a tactile, welcoming, and high-trust environment.

secondary.description: Warm coral accent used sparingly for notifications, badges, or high-urgency CTAs (like 'Only 1 left').

search_map_screen.structure: React Native Map occupying 100% of background. A floating absolute search bar at top (SafeArea + 16px). A floating horizontal FlatList of categories (Cars, Bikes, Tools, Tech) below search. A bottom sheet (using @gorhom/bottom-sheet) presenting the list view of visible items on the map.
search_map_screen.map_markers: Custom markers with white background, #7C3AED text (price), subtle drop shadow, rounded pill shape.
search_map_screen.bottom_sheet_cards: Horizontal row layout. Image left (80x80), Details right (Title, Category, Price/day, Rating). No heavy shadows, 1px border.

listing_detail.structure: ScrollView. Hero image slider (height: 300px) extending to top edge. Absolute back button and 'Favorite' heart in top corners (glassmorphism circles). Below image: Title, Rating, Location. Owner profile row (avatar + name). Description. Features grid. Fixed bottom bar for Booking CTA.
listing_detail.bottom_cta_bar: Fixed at bottom, white background, shadow-top. Left: Price/day bold text. Right: Primary button 'Book Now'.

booking_flow.structure: Step 1: Calendar Selection (React Native Calendars, primary color #7C3AED for selected range). Step 2: Order Summary (Dates, Item, Total calculation, Service Fee). Step 3: Stripe Payment Integration via @stripe/stripe-react-native (PaymentSheet).
booking_flow.design_feel: Clean, highly trustworthy, lots of whitespace. Focus purely on numbers and dates.

create_listing.structure: Multi-step wizard or long ScrollView. Image upload area is prominent (dashed border, #7C3AED icon). Native inputs for Title, Price. Dropdown for Category. Location uses MapView to pin exact address.
create_listing.owner_mode: Distinct toggle in profile to switch to 'Owner Mode'. App accent color could subtly shift or use a 'Hosting' badge to clarify mode.

profile.structure: Header with User Avatar, Name, Member Since. Grid of stats (Rentals, Listings, Rating). Two main sections: 'My Rentals' (upcoming/past) and 'My Listings' (manage inventory). Settings, Payments, Support links.

patterns.button_press: Scale down to 0.96, opacity 0.9, duration 150ms spring.
patterns.map_to_list: Smooth snapping using BottomSheet. As sheet moves up, map markers subtly fade or map zooms out slightly.
patterns.tab_switch: Active icon bounces slightly, inactive icons scale down to 0.9.

hero_onboarding.description: Young woman with curly hair talks on her smartphone in an urban outdoor setting. Conveys modern city living.

car.description: White electric car charging on an urban city street

category_icons.instructions: Use lucide-react-native icons: 'Car' for vehicles, 'Bike' for bikes, 'Wrench' or 'Hammer' for tools, 'Camera' for tech/photo, 'Tent' for camping.

testing.instructions: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tab items) and key text fields MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (or `testID` for React Native) to facilitate robust automated testing. Example: `testID='explore-tab-button'` or `testID='book-now-button'`.
